name: Deploy Website
description: Deploy a static website from Google Drive to Firebase Hosting. Downloads the site content from a Drive folder, deploys to a staging preview channel for approval, then promotes to production after owner sign-off.

drive_folder_id.description: Google Drive folder ID containing the website files

firebase_project.description: Firebase project ID for hosting deployment

deploy_dir.description: Local directory to stage the website files

steps.title: Download website content from Google Drive
steps.description:
Download all website files from the Google Drive folder to the local deploy directory.

1. Clean the deploy directory if it already exists: `rm -rf ${deploy_dir} && mkdir -p ${deploy_dir}`
2. Read the `workspace-drive` SKILL.md to understand available tools
3. Use `drive-download-folder ${drive_folder_id} --output ${deploy_dir}` to recursively download all files and subdirectories
4. Verify the download with `ls -R ${deploy_dir}` and confirm files were downloaded

⚠️ Do NOT use parallel `drive-download` calls — always use `drive-download-folder` for recursive downloads.

Output: list of all downloaded files and total count.
steps.accept_criteria: Files are downloaded to the deploy directory. The output lists all files and confirms a non-zero count. No download errors occurred.

steps.title: Create Firebase Hosting configuration
steps.accept_criteria: firebase.json exists in the deploy directory with valid hosting configuration pointing public to the current directory.

steps.title: Deploy to staging preview channel
steps.description:
Deploy the website to a Firebase Hosting preview channel for review.

Run this command:
```bash
cd ${deploy_dir} && firebase hosting:channel:deploy staging --project=${firebase_project} --expires 7d
```

Extract the staging preview URL from the command output (look for 'Channel URL').

Output: the staging preview URL.
steps.accept_criteria: The firebase hosting:channel:deploy command ran successfully (output shows 'Deploy complete'). The staging preview URL is extracted and reported.

steps.title: Request owner approval
steps.description:
Report the staging URL to the owner and request approval before promoting to production.

Send a message with:
- The staging preview URL
- A summary of what was deployed (file count, folder structure)
- A request for the owner to review and approve for production deployment

⚠️ STOP HERE and wait for owner approval. Do NOT proceed to production deployment without explicit approval.
steps.accept_criteria: The staging URL and deployment summary have been reported. The message clearly requests owner approval before proceeding.

steps.title: Deploy to production
steps.description:
After receiving owner approval, deploy to the live production site.

Run this command:
```bash
cd ${deploy_dir} && firebase deploy --only hosting --project=${firebase_project}
```

Extract the production Hosting URL from the command output (look for 'Hosting URL').

Output: the production URL.
steps.accept_criteria: The firebase deploy command ran successfully (output shows 'Deploy complete'). The production URL is extracted and reported.

steps.title: Verify production deployment
steps.description:
Perform a basic smoke test of the production site.

1. Fetch the homepage and verify it contains expected content (title tag, meta description)
2. Check that key static assets load (CSS, images)
3. Verify any subpages are accessible (e.g., /about.html, /security.html)

Output: verification results for each check (PASS/FAIL).
steps.accept_criteria: Homepage loads with expected content. Key static assets are accessible. At least 2 subpages verified. All checks PASS or issues are documented.
